wholePhysicalScope: The named Main Building’s 63 mapped corners and independent fitted circles control both domes, connecting hall and east range. The native telescope pin is inside the south drum. Two cleared photographs document the west entrance and the domes.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve both unequal dome drums, connecting hall, east range and west portal. Closer levels refine the rotating shutter seams, window recesses, cornice and entry steps.
limitations: The 2019 exterior interpretation covers the Main Building, both attached domes and the east range. It depicts the south observing shutter closed.
The historic handbook and mapped footprint constrain the main dimensions. East-range fenestration, elevations, roof profiles and material wear are estimated.
The original summit terrain remains unchanged. The exposed foundation follows an approximate local grade.
